_comment: Shot list for episode 10, the last of four on the Law. 10 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order); the look back reuses one picture from each Law episode, and the Temple market and overturned tables come from episode 5. No imagined scenes are spoken in this series.
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel and its neighbours. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. No modern objects. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.

shots.prompt: A narrow lane in an old stone town bends sharply around a high blank wall, so you cannot see what is coming round the corner.
shots.description: A narrow lane in an old stone town bends sharply around a high blank wall, so you cannot see what is coming round the corner; warm afternoon light on one side, deep shade on the other, a single bird on the wall. No people.
At the entrance to the sanctuary court, a shepherd holds a young lamb while a priest in white looks on.
The bronze altar in the tabernacle courtyard.
A photograph treated to match the paintings: Brian as a young sailor in Navy whites, with Patti beside him. A small plate beneath him reads Mister Scaredy Cat.
The white cane leaning against a church pew. Brian speaks.
The shepherd and the lamb at the sanctuary court.

Episode 10: The blind animal and the altar

shots.description: A shepherd seen from behind kneels in a sheepfold at morning among ewes and their newborn lambs, gently lifting one small lamb, a low stone wall and hills beyond. Tender and quiet.
The open scroll.

shots.prompt: Evening in a village courtyard: a family shares a meal of bread and roasted meat by lamplight, children among them.
shots.description: Evening in the courtyard of a simple village house: a family sits on mats around a shared meal of bread and roasted meat by the light of a clay lamp, children among them, seen from behind and the side, faces turned away or in shadow. Warm and ordinary.

shots.description: A man with a long walking staff, seen from behind, walks steadily along a quiet road through hill country at sunrise, his free hand trailing along a low stone wall beside the road, the light ahead of him. Hopeful.

shots.prompt: The courtyard of the rebuilt Temple: a prophet in a rough cloak, seen from behind, speaks to a group of priests by the altar.
shots.description: The courtyard of the rebuilt Temple in Jerusalem, plainer than Solomon's: a lean prophet in a rough cloak, seen from behind, stands speaking to a small group of priests in white near the altar, some of whom have turned away. Late afternoon light.
The open scroll.
Malachi before the priests.

shots.card: Try offering that to your governor
shots.prompt: The hall of a Persian governor: a seated official on a raised dais while a petitioner, seen at a distance, holds out a fine young ram.
shots.description: The hall of a Persian governor: a seated official on a raised dais under a canopy, seen from a distance, while a petitioner bows before him holding out a gift of a fine young ram. Columns, rich hangings, warm light. No faces close up.

shots.prompt: A man, seen from behind, leads a thin, limping sheep out through the gate while a fine ram stands behind him in the fold.
shots.description: Dawn in a farmyard: a man seen from behind leads a thin, limping sheep out through the gate on a rope, while behind him in the fold a strong, fine ram stands watching. Quiet, a little sorrowful, not graphic.
Matthew Henry's study.

shots.at_phrase: The first is the very first offering
shots.prompt: Two stone altars on open ground: from one smoke rises straight and bright, from the other a thin smoke drifts low; two small figures beside them.
shots.description: Two simple stone altars on open ground under a wide sky, at a distance from each other: from one, smoke rises straight and bright toward a break in the clouds; from the other, a thin smoke drifts low along the ground. Two figures stand by them, seen from behind, small.

shots.at_phrase: The second place is King David.
shots.prompt: A hilltop threshing floor with oxen and a threshing sled; a king, seen from behind, holds out a purse of silver to the farmer.
shots.description: A threshing floor on a hilltop above a city, a wide circle of beaten earth with sheaves and a wooden threshing sled, a yoke of oxen standing by; a king in a dark cloak, seen from behind, holds out a heavy purse of silver to a farmer. Morning light.
The open scroll.

shots.prompt: In a Temple colonnade, a poor widow in a dark shawl, seen from behind, drops two small coins into a bronze collection chest.
shots.description: In a colonnade of the Temple, a row of tall bronze trumpet-shaped collection chests; a poor widow in a plain dark shawl, seen from behind, reaches up to drop two small coins into one, while richly dressed men stand a little apart. Soft light between the columns.
The open scroll.
